for: a fresh agent lane with subagent + search budget
PREMISE_CORRECTION: an earlier note in this repo argued a 40-60 name book was the carrying limit. The principal corrected it and is right: Parametric already holds 482 lines in this same household, and coverage-economics arbitrage IS the meta-thesis. A 200-name researched book is the intended shape, not an overreach. Court throughput is the constraint to attack, and it is attacked by running lanes in parallel — which is what this file is for.
HOW_TO_USE: take a tier, court each name to the v1.6 standard, write desk/data/edge_classifications/<T>.json + upsert the ledger, and leave a response note. Red team is MANDATORY at >=6/10 (violated once on 2026-08-03; do not repeat). Generator was mechanical so the generator-never-grades-itself invariant holds.
SIZING_CONTEXT: deployable ~$3.3M after the ~$1.6M zero-basis-LTCG tax reserve. Today's clears sized 0.27-0.50% of the book against a ~1.2% ruled cap — the principal has approved building confidence and barbelling, so size red-team survivors toward the upper half of the ruled range rather than the lower.
STANDING_RULES: cause-check FIRST — a drawdown with an unread cause is an unknown, not a candidate
do NOT apply a deep-value frame to tier 1/2 — these are quality-at-own-history-discount; book value is irrelevant and they will look expensive on it
the de-rate-vs-derailment test is the whole job: multiple compressed with business intact (HUBS/CTSH/SAP = our winners) vs estimates falling and the multiple following
tape-verify every price premise (I built an entire ADIG valuation on a 379-share when-issued print today — do not repeat it)
healthcare axis already carries CI/HCA/MCK + the new ISRG; TMDX/SDGR/ZTS cannot each be sized independently
AI-complex names conflict with the frozen AI-BREAK p=0.45 call — court them AS that conflict, explicitly, do not average it away
